authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / 298 authoritative data providers
note: Previously unused official public no-login real-data source window. Planning Data states the Brownfield land dataset contains 37,736 sites from authoritative sources and is intended to identify sites suitable for residential or other development, making it relevant to future-growth evidence. A bounded window of at most 50 candidates was considered. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA/local-plan-boundary reference, local-authority code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, title identifier, brownfield reference, or equivalent selector binding any candidate site Polygon/MultiPolygon to this slot. Selecting a candidate would invent partition ownership. Therefore no coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
